summary.text: Alicia St. Germaine is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 62 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Alicia St. Germaine's general-election opponent is Matthew Smith (D).
She is Majority Vice Chair of the Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Alicia St. Germaine served on the board of USA Michigan Swim and has been affiliated with Michigan for Vaccine Choice, the Fraternal Order of Eagles, and the Moose Lodge.
St. Germaine assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023.
In 2025-2026 she is Majority Vice Chair of the Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation Committee and also serves on the Economic Competitiveness, Education, and Health Policy committees.
